rationale: The plan diagnoses the design correctly and its Step 1 is exactly right: library-size normalization, a justified expression floor, descriptive log2FC ranking, sample correlation and MA/scatter QC appropriate to n=2, with an explicit statement that no variance estimate exists. But Step 2 then runs edgeR exactTest with an assumed BCV and exports nominal and BH-adjusted p-values, FDR<0.05 gene counts and a volcano plot; extensive labelling does not undo the fact that the plan manufactures inferential-looking output on a design that supports none, which the reference explicitly rules out. It also never states the replication level that would restore inference (at least two, preferably three or more per group), and gives no design formula or reference-level statement. The enrichment step compounds the problem by generating NES with nominal and adjusted p-values from an unreplicated single-pair ranking, where the correct move was to omit enrichment; it is otherwise well specified (human WikiPathways, full unthresholded ranking, mapping rate, leading edge) but lacks collection version and gene-set size window. Reporting names methods, thresholds and design caveats but omits software versions.
